prompt_inputs.goal: Strength gain and muscle hypertrophy for competitive weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3,500+ calories across all meals
Minimum 200g protein distributed across meals with emphasis on pre- and post-training
Includes at least one meal timed within 2 hours before training and one within 2 hours after training
Plan is compact and presented in a single day format with clear meal schedule
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-sport athlete (weightlifter) needing 3,500+ calories with high protein intake and specific meal timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading and optimal hydration for a 42km race tomorrow

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 4,000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 60-65% of total intake
Includes 3+ hydration strategies (water intake targets, electrolyte sources, or timing)
Provides 5-6 eating occasions (meals and snacks) distributed throughout the day
All meals are vegetarian and nut-free
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 4,000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrate loading and hydration strategy

prompt_inputs.goal: High-performance soccer training with matches and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 2,800 calories across all meals and snacks
Macronutrients are balanced with adequate protein (1.6-2.0g per kg body weight) for muscle recovery and carbohydrates for energy
Meals are strategically timed around morning training, midday match/practice, and evening recovery periods
Plan is compact and presented in a clear, easy-to-follow single-day format
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a mixed-sport athlete (soccer player) requiring 2,800 calories with balanced macronutrients and energy distribution across morning, midday, and evening activities
